subject: Strategic Fintech Roundtable — sponsorship alignment, NDAs, and venue logistics
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.z@clearbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Sponsorship alignment for fintech CTO roundtable

Hi Ben/Laura —

Thanks again for inviting ClearBank to be a sponsor for the Nov 19 fintech CTO roundtable. We wanted to clarify a few items before we finalize:

1) Brand placement: we can confirm logo at registration table and one pop-up banner by the entrance. Can you confirm there will be a sponsor table and a 6ft space for a banner?
2) Speaking slot: we were told there might be a 5–7 minute sponsor intro — is that confirmed?
3) Guestlist/privacy: we need to confirm there will be an NDA for attendees and that our marketing team won’t be included on the event attendee list for outreach.

I attached our standard sponsor terms (.pdf). Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Emily Zhao
Head of Strategic Partnerships
ClearBank

Attachments: ClearBank_Sponsor_Terms_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.z@clearbank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, events@lumenhall.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sponsorship alignment for fintech CTO roundtable

Hi Emily —

Thanks — really excited to have ClearBank on board. Quick answers:
- Sponsor table + one 6ft banner at the entrance: confirmed with Lumen Hall (cc'd).
- Speaking slot: we can offer a 5-minute sponsor intro immediately after the opening remarks; will include speaker mic and slide.
- NDA & guestlist: Redwood will require a one-page NDA for attendees (data protection/privacy only) and we will not share the guest contact list with sponsor marketing teams. We can provide a sanitized attendee list (company + title) after the event.

Next steps I propose:
1) Laura to review and redline the venue contract (attached).
2) Events team to confirm AV and banner placement with Lumen Hall.
3) Emily — please confirm the name of the person giving the sponsor intro and logo files.

Attaching Venue_Contract_v2.pdf and the latest guestlist (link in email footer). I’ll circulate a DocuSign envelope once internal redlines are done.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Venue_Contract_v2.pdf (pdf); Roundtable_Guestlist_v3.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sponsorship alignment for fintech CTO roundtable

Ben —

I reviewed Venue_Contract_v2 and attached a redlined version. Key items I flagged:
- Cancellation fees: vendor penalty language is asymmetric — requested cap at 50% of deposit for cancellations >60 days out.
- Insurance: venue is asking for full commercial liability naming Lumen Hall only; I added Redwood + ClearBank as additional insured for the event day.
- Force majeure: broadened to include vendor insolvency and public health advisories.
- AV/technical rider: requested a technical check 24 hours prior and a contact name for on-site support.

Also, procurement asked that any third-party sponsor freebies (e.g., swag) have a pre-clearance if they include vendor data capture devices. I suggested a sponsor swag waiver.

I signed the one-page attendee NDA template (attached as NDA_Redwood_signed.pdf) and uploaded it to the shared folder. Once Venue_Contract_v2_redline is accepted, Ben please send to Lumen Hall and loop in procurement.

Laura Bennett
Head of Events & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Venue_Contract_v2_redline.pdf (pdf); NDA_Redwood_signed.pdf (pdf)

Michael/Emily —

Thanks all — final confirmation below:

1) RSVPs: Acme Payments noted 3 attendees (vegetarian, no dairy) — noted in the guestlist.
2) Travel stipends: Redwood can offer a modest stipend (up to $350/person) for verified travel. Procurement needs a short confirmation email; I’ve attached a one-line invoice template and will issue a reimbursement confirmation after the event.
3) Venue contract & NDAs: Laura’s redlines have been shared with Lumen Hall. Lumen Hall provided a revised clean copy this morning; I uploaded it to Drive and sent DocuSign for signatures. Link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/SF-56372-CTO.
4) Sponsor logistics: Emily — sponsor table and banner confirmed. Please share logo files (PNG/SVG) to events@redwoodinference.com by Tue, Nov 17 COB. Sponsor intro slot confirmed for 5 minutes after opening remarks.

Final attachments (for reference): Venue_Contract_v2_redline.pdf; NDA_Redwood_signed.pdf; Roundtable_Guestlist_v3.xlsx.

If no objections, I’ll close the loop with a calendar invite to registered attendees with arrival instructions and a short background packet.

— Ben
